0:00
Thank you all for coming. I want to tell you what we learned from our four day week trial.
0:07
Sixty one companies took part, and staff worked four days for the same pay.
0:14
After six months, fifty six of the sixty one companies chose to keep the four day week.
0:22
Eighteen of them made it permanent straight away.
1:03
Revenue stayed broadly the same over the trial period, rising slightly on average.
1:10
The number of staff leaving fell by more than half compared with the same months a year before.
1:18
Fewer people reported burnout, and most said they slept better.
2:05
Not every company found it easy. Five of them went back to five days.
2:11
Our view as a campaign is that a shorter week can work for many employers, with careful planning.
